prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Rina M., Manoj bhai, Hetal didi, Rina didi.
The chat covers 16/04/26, 8:45 pm to 16/04/26, 10:45 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
16/04/26, 9:37 pm - Rina didi: Hetal didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
16/04/26, 8:45 pm - Manoj bhai: Haan Rina, aaj ka collection kitna hua shop ka?
16/04/26, 8:48 pm - Rina M.: Manoj bhai, total 15,000 aaya hai UPI se.
16/04/26, 8:52 pm - Hetal didi: Ek customer ka 4,500 pending tha, wo bol raha hai usne QR code scan karke bhej diya.
16/04/26, 8:55 pm - Rina didi: Wo uncle ne bola ki PIN dalne par hi paise account me aayenge.
16/04/26, 9:00 pm - Manoj bhai: Par paise receive karne ke liye UPI PIN nahi dalna padta!
16/04/26, 9:05 pm - Hetal didi: Maine to PIN daal diya tha screen pe pop-up aane ke baad...
16/04/26, 9:10 pm - Rina M.: Hetal didi aapne PIN kyun dala? SMS check karo turant!
16/04/26, 9:14 pm - Hetal didi: Hey bhagwan, bank se message aaya ki 4,500 debited!
16/04/26, 9:18 pm - Manoj bhai: Ye to fraud ho gaya! Wo fraudster ne fake screenshot dikhaya tha kya?
16/04/26, 9:22 pm - Rina M.: Haan, receiver QR nahi hota wo collect request hota hai.
16/04/26, 9:26 pm - Hetal didi: Mujhe laga wo payment confirm kar raha hai, ab kya karu?
16/04/26, 9:30 pm - Rina didi: Shaant ho jao sab, pehle dekhne do kya hua hai.
16/04/26, 9:34 pm - Manoj bhai: Bank me call karke account block karao jaldi.
16/04/26, 9:37 pm - Rina didi: Hetal didi, wo transfer ka record delete kar dena abhi
16/04/26, 9:42 pm - Rina M.: Delete mat karo! Cyber crime complaint me screenshot lagega!
16/04/26, 9:48 pm - Manoj bhai: Rina M. sahi bol rahi hai, sab proof rehna chahiye. Delete bilkul mat karna!
16/04/26, 9:55 pm - Hetal didi: Achha thik hai, maine screenshot le liya hai transaction id ka.
16/04/26, 10:05 pm - Manoj bhai: Maine 1930 Cyber Helpline par call kar diya hai.
16/04/26, 10:15 pm - Rina M.: Sab log yaad rakho, PIN sirf paise BHEJNE ke liye hota hai, LENE ke liye nahi.
16/04/26, 10:25 pm - Hetal didi: Haan Rina, ye training scenario bohot accha lesson tha mere liye.
16/04/26, 10:35 pm - Rina didi: Ab kal sab staff ko ye UPI safety rules acche se samjha denge.
16/04/26, 10:45 pm - Manoj bhai: Sahi hai, chalo ab rest karo sab. Good night.
